title: Blocking stress signalling prevents anatomical homeostasis in a stress-using tissue

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Blocking stress signalling prevents anatomical homeostasis in a stress-using tissue

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In an evolved neural cellular automaton tissue that uses stress as an instructive signal, forcing stress to zero throughout life (a simulated anxiolytic) lowered pattern accuracy (82.8% vs 95.1% at step 90) and killed the red-stripe cells, so anatomical homeostasis was neither reached nor maintained.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The scaling of goals from cellular to anatomical homeostasis: an evolutionary simulation, experiment and analysis

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Pio-Lopez L 2023, The scaling of goals from cellular to anatomical homeostasis: an evolutionary simulation, experiment and analysis › Computational results › Evolution exploits stress as an instructive signal to reach the target morphology

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: These experiments reveal that, in the absence of stress, anatomical homeostasis is not reached nor maintained during the lifetime of the cells.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Pio-Lopez L, Bischof J, LaPalme JV, Levin M, “The scaling of goals from cellular to anatomical homeostasis: an evolutionary simulation, experiment and analysis”, Interface focus (2023), doi:10.1098/rsfs.2022.0072; section “Computational results › Evolution exploits stress as an instructive signal to reach the target morphology”. Scope: One evolved tissue in the 2D neural cellular automaton model that uses stress instructively

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-goals-06: resolvable-now, resolvability 0.96

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: This is a controlled computational ablation with explicit numerical outcomes and public code. It can be directly confirmed or refuted.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Run the identified controller with normal stress and with stress clamped to zero, then compare step-90 accuracy, red-cell survival, and later maintenance. The stated numerical contrast and failure of homeostasis are direct endpoints.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Clamping stress to zero is a strong intervention with possible downstream effects.

The claim concerns one stress-using evolved tissue, not all tissues.

analysis feasibility: 0.91
data existence: 0.98

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Zeroing stress and reading pattern accuracy is a well-specified intervention in the model. The claim is about one stress-using individual and two precise percentages, and those genomes are not public. A new evolution can look for the phenomenon, but it will not reliably replay this tissue, so the stated result is only partly resolvable.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: On a tissue that uses stress instructively, clamp stress to zero for the whole run and compare pattern accuracy and red-stripe survival with the unclamped run. Accuracy near 82.8 percent versus 95.1 percent at step 90, plus loss of the red stripe, would reproduce the result; unchanged accuracy would refute dependence in that tissue.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The percentages belong to one evolved tissue that is not archived in the repository.

Re-evolved tissues often solve the flag without using stress, so a random rerun may not be the stress-using case.
